source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Historical D210712 suggested as_ for a header representation; the author chose to_auth_header_value because conversion was not free. That 2024 method name is historical. Current shared AuthenticationProvider uses a different auth_header_value operation and does not establish that prefix. Proposed scoped Rust naming rule: distinguish a borrowed view, allocating conversion and consuming conversion when the new API has those semantics. Do not infer a global get_/as_/to_ policy from this one review.
title: Use conversion names that reflect ownership and cost instead of an ordinary getter
